dataFileDescription: A veritable sample of who's who and who isn't in the world of radio
helpTitle: How to build your own callsign notes
helpText:
A callsign notes file is plain text, one entry per line: a callsign, then a space, then the note. You can use the built-in files above or add your own.

Provide a direct link to a plain text file, or a "share link" from a service like:

- [Google Docs](https://docs.google.com/)
- [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/)
- [GitHub Gists](https://gist.github.com/)
- [Dropbox](https://www.dropbox.com/)
- [Apple iCloud Drive](https://www.icloud.com/)

Lines should look like this:

```
KI2D 🤩 Sebastián - Ham2K PoLo Creator
W1AW Hiram Percy Maxim Memorial Station
DAN WD4DAN,WD4JMM
```

Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored — use them for a title or comments. The same callsign can appear on more than one line; every note for that call is kept. A note can start with an emoji, which is shown as a marker next to the call.

Entries can be used for callsign expansion: typing `//DAN` in the callsign field expands to `WD4DAN,WD4JMM`, as long as the note is just a comma-separated list of calls.
